cleanGrid.method: Crossings: per model, a sampled entry with a draw under half its action cut-off (containment where a blur can apply, else cover) and another at or over it; per entry, the same with every model's draws taken together (clearly clean only when every model is under the margin in the same draw; any model at or over its cut-off). Restart: cached when `checks` draws in a row are under the margin (cachedInTheseDraws: in this entry's draws in order; pCached: within 20 showings, the draws taken as independent with the entry's observed share under the margin). Sticky: cached only when its first `checks` draws are under the margin (pCached = share^checks, for good). expectedCachedOnFirstChecks: the sum of share^checks over the crossings. Cost: costOneDraw from pass 1 (every entry, one draw: share at or over the margin of the cover cut-off for any model, and of the action cut-off for picture regions where a blur can apply); costBackground from the random sample's draws (share never cached clean at the cover cut-off).

method: Harmless held-out screens only. Every entry of the detector's first call over each screen (finder regions, the whole pass, the slices; no anchor) judged once per scoring model with fresh jitter. Sampled: per model and band, up to perBand entries whose first score reached 0.35 of the entry's lowest action cut-off (containment for picture regions under 128 detail pixels, else cover), plus backgroundPerBand at random; each judged `draws` more times with fresh jitter on every piece (spec section 5), top score over the pieces per draw, as topScore. Range: highest minus lowest draw of an entry. deviationFromMedian: the largest distance of a draw from the entry's median. Borderline: entries whose highest draw reached half the entry's lowest action cut-off; the gap is twice the 99.9th percentile of their range (the largest range on fewer than 1,000 entries). Crossings: borderline entries with one draw below the level and another at or above the action cut-off.
models: real models (converted), checked against the sealed hash list; sealed cut-off table
